tasks.title: Install complete-bank capability ASDL root
tasks.detail: Implement the target architecture from docs/RESIDUAL_NATIVE_ARCHITECTURE.md: add precise ASDL for NativeCompleteBankCapability and closed class vocabularies needed to enumerate the complete bank (value classes, logical location classes, Code/ABI/Kernel/Stencil micro-op family classes, runtime/frame/constant/atomic capabilities). This is ASDL-first: no generic tables/maps, no sampled support-domain-as-complete-bank, no program-shaped payloads. Keep existing subset/test support helpers only as subset helpers if needed.
tasks.evidence: Changed `lua/lalin/schema/native.lua`: added `NativeCompleteBankCapabilityId`, `NativeCompleteBankCapability`, closed complete-bank value/scalar/location class vocabularies, runtime/frame/constant-pool/atomic capability products, and Code/ABI/Kernel/Stencil `*MicroOpShape` capability products without CodeSig/CodeType/field-name/rank/count/size/stride/scale/step/flag axes. Verified with `luajit tests/schema/test_schema_native.lua`, `luajit tests/run.lua schema`, and `luajit tests/code_ir/test_native_template_sources.lua`.

tasks.title: Replace complete-bank source generation root
tasks.detail: Add constructors/helpers for NativeCompleteBankCapability and complete-bank manifest/request generation. Complete bank generation must start from closed capability classes, not host_scalar/support-domain samples. Update source support APIs so subset/test support lists are clearly separate from complete bank APIs.
tasks.evidence: Changed `lua/lalin/native_template_support.lua` and `lua/lalin/native_template_sources.lua`: added NativeCompleteBankCapability constructors/helpers, closed complete-bank default capability construction from target/scalar classes and micro-op class lists, separate complete-bank IDs from subset NativeTemplateSupportDomain IDs, and root `NativeCompleteBankCapability:native_template_manifest/native_template_sources/native_template_bank_request` methods that start from capability micro-op classes. Kept existing support-domain APIs as subset/test helpers. Verified with `luajit tests/schema/test_schema_native.lua`, `luajit tests/run.lua schema`, `luajit tests/code_ir/test_native_template_sources.lua`, `LUA_PATH='./?.lua;./?/init.lua;./lua/?.lua;./lua/?/init.lua;;' luajit -e '... S.host_complete_bank_capability() ...'`, and an empty complete-bank request smoke using `NativeCompleteBankCapability:native_template_bank_request()`.

tasks.title: Normalize Code and ABI complete-bank micro-op axes
tasks.detail: Replace complete-bank Code/ABI source-family selection that depends on CodeType, CodeSig, NativeAbiFunctionProjection, exact layout, or full signatures with closed micro-op classes and graph composition. Type/layout/signature facts must bind through layout/projection/lowering inputs, holes, frame/runtime values, or repeated graph nodes.
tasks.evidence: Implemented Code/ABI complete-bank micro-op family axes and source generation. Changed lua/lalin/schema/native.lua to add NativeRoleAbiMicroOp plus NativeAxisCodeMicroOp/NativeAxisAbiMicroOp; lua/lalin/native.lua to compare these axes; lua/lalin/native_template_support.lua to construct Code/ABI micro-op families; lua/lalin/native_template_sources.lua to expand NativeCompleteCodeCapability/NativeCompleteAbiCapability into closed micro-op sources without CodeType/CodeSig/NativeAbiFunctionProjection axes; tests/code_ir/test_native_template_sources.lua adds a complete Code/ABI capability assertion that generated families carry micro-op axes and not CodeType/CodeSig axes. Checks run: luajit tests/schema/test_schema_native.lua; luajit tests/code_ir/test_native_template_sources.lua; luajit tests/run.lua schema; luajit tests/run.lua code_ir (50 passed, 1 skipped); ad-hoc complete Code/ABI bank request smoke.

tasks.title: Normalize Kernel complete-bank micro-op axes
tasks.detail: Refactor Kernel source shapes/methods/source builders so complete-bank axes no longer carry bytes size/alignment, affine term_count, logical term_count, call effect_count, body lane/binding/effect counts, concrete Kernel semantic values, or program-specific facts. Use primitive micro-op graph nodes and repeated graph structure; bind layout/count payloads through holes/frame/runtime/lowering facets.
tasks.evidence: Implemented Kernel complete-bank micro-op axes/source expansion. Changed lua/lalin/schema/native.lua to add NativeRoleKernelMicroOp and NativeAxisKernelMicroOp; lua/lalin/native.lua to compare the new axis; lua/lalin/native_template_support.lua to build kernel micro-op families and restrict pointer load/store micro-ops to NativeScalarPointer; lua/lalin/native_template_sources.lua to tokenize and generate Kernel complete-bank micro-op C sources without NativeKernelSourceShapeAxis/projection axes or count/size/layout family payloads; tests/code_ir/test_native_template_sources.lua now asserts complete Kernel requests expand primitive micro-op sources with NativeAxisKernelMicroOp and no exact Kernel axes. Checks run: luajit tests/schema/test_schema_native.lua; luajit tests/code_ir/test_native_template_sources.lua; luajit tests/run.lua schema; luajit tests/run.lua code_ir (50 passed, 1 skipped); ad-hoc complete Kernel helper/request smoke.

tasks.title: Normalize Stencil complete-bank micro-op axes
tasks.detail: Refactor Stencil source shapes/methods/source builders so complete-bank axes no longer carry bytes size/alignment, ranks/window_count/tile_count, step/stride/scale/term_count, field_name/SoA names, point offset_count, arbitrary schedule flags/named targets/features, or concrete Stencil semantic identities. Use primitive micro-op graph nodes; bind payloads through holes/frame/runtime/lowering facets.
tasks.evidence: Implemented Stencil complete-bank micro-op axes/source expansion. Changed lua/lalin/schema/native.lua to add NativeRoleStencilMicroOp and NativeAxisStencilMicroOp; lua/lalin/native.lua to compare the new axis; lua/lalin/native_template_support.lua to build stencil micro-op families; lua/lalin/native_template_sources.lua to tokenize closed Stencil micro-op classes and generate Stencil complete-bank sources without producer/access/point/body/sink/schedule exact source-shape axes or rank/count/field-name/schedule-flag family payloads; tests/code_ir/test_native_template_sources.lua now asserts complete Stencil requests expand primitive micro-op sources with NativeAxisStencilMicroOp and no exact Stencil axes. Checks run: luajit tests/schema/test_schema_native.lua; luajit tests/code_ir/test_native_template_sources.lua; luajit tests/run.lua schema; luajit tests/run.lua code_ir (50 passed, 1 skipped); ad-hoc complete Stencil helper/request smoke.

tasks.title: Build and verify complete language native bank
tasks.detail: Actual `make native-complete-bank` failed. Complete-bank manifest/root exists, but generator rejects emitted sources. Must fix concrete source-builder/manifest issues before complete bank can be generated: missing declared NativeTemplateRelocationConstantPool for many stencil point_cast sources; unresolved `memcpy` in stencil sink_store sources (must be builtin/inlined or declared typed runtime symbol); compile errors for invalid float bitwise reductions/scans/scatter-reduces such as and/or/xor over f32/f64. Then rerun full make, compile C bridge, and import Lua ASDL bank.
tasks.evidence: Unblocked and verified complete language native bank generation. Changed `lua/lalin/native_template_support.lua` to restrict invalid float bitwise reducer/scan/scatter-reduce combinations while keeping integer bitwise reducers. Changed `lua/lalin/native_template_sources.lua` to declare constant-pool relocations for float cast/unary sources, inline byte-copy/move loops instead of unresolved memcpy/memmove, emit robust non-executed hole relocation markers for optimized-away frame/access holes, avoid call-hole extern redeclaration, and inline stencil sink-store byte copies. Changed `tools/gen_lalin_mc_bank.lua` Lua bridge emission to chunk large manifest/entry tables through nested functions so the complete 7426-template ASDL bank imports under LuaJIT constant limits. Verified `make native-complete-bank` succeeds, compiled `target/lalin_binary/lalin_complete_native_template_bank.c` to an object, imported `target/lalin_binary/lalin_complete_native_template_bank.lua` as a typed `NativeEmbeddedTemplateBank`, imported it through `NativeEmbeddedBankImportRequest`, and asserted 7426 entries match manifest count. Also ran `luajit tests/schema/test_schema_native.lua`, `luajit tests/code_ir/test_native_template_sources.lua`, `luajit tests/code_ir/test_native_bank_generator.lua`, `luajit tests/run.lua schema`, and `luajit tests/run.lua code_ir` (50 passed, 1 skipped).
notes: Manual verification after worker completion ran `make native-complete-bank`; it failed. Representative rejects: NativeBuildRejectUnsupportedRelocation for NativeTemplateRelocationConstantPool in stencil.micro.point_cast.* sources; NativeBuildRejectExtraUnresolvedSymbol `memcpy` in stencil.micro.sink_store.*; NativeBuildRejectCompileError for sink_scan/sink_reduce/sink_scatter_reduce and/or/xor over f32/f64. Full output saved by tool at /tmp/pi-bash-8af37fcd3381d8b5.log.
